bayts.text: O our Lord, bless and grant peace for ever upon the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad,
his Family, his Companions, the prophets and the messengers; and be for me, my Lord.
And make, by the right of Your noble Face, O Giver of protection and honour,
the letters of this composition the best of blessings, and accept with thanks the stillnesses and movements together.
O our Lord, O Lord of the earths and the sky, bless perpetually, with a lofty peace,
him whom You set foremost, magnified, our master Muḥammad, he who is great,
his Family and his Companions; and turn, O You toward Whom is my turning for ever,
every enemy toward other than my precinct, O You to Whom goes my praise, abundant.
Spread over me blessings without harm, and hold back toward others than me all that harms.
O You Who once turned away from me the one who would kill me, (sending him back) remorseful; O You Who through the Prophet spared me the one who struck at me,
just as You made my striving and my past pacts the best of deeds, well-pleasing,
bless with a peace without end the Prophet of Allah, bestower of gifts,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my pens and my ink, (devoted) to God and to the Messenger, a shield against every heedless one.
And make my writing like righteous deeds, and lead my hopes to me.
And make my script, for Your noble Face, a blessing that lets the burden (of sins) fall.
And make my letters, by the rank of the Chosen One, among the greatest works of piety and kindness.
And through him make my composition above fasting and the other things that prevent blame.
And make glad tidings and security everlasting for me, for ever, with good pleasure. Āmīn.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Beloved!
Pour a blessing with peace, for ever, upon him whom You named Muḥammad,
upon his Family and his Companions, people of piety, O Forgiver of sin and Giver of ascent.
Bless with Your peace, praised Lord, him whom You named Aḥmad,
the Family, the Companions and every upright one, O You Who through him guided to the straight path.
And bless, O Lord to Whom belong all praises, a magnified one whose name is Ḥāmid,
his Family and his upright Companions, O You Who guard against idolatry and alteration.
And grant him peace, and make this composition the gate of good pleasure, together with Your immense favours.
Bless and grant peace, O Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), upon him whose name is Maḥmūd,
his Family and his following Companions, O Giver of love together with following.
And bless, O Single One (Al-Fard) to Whom belongs the affirmation of oneness, him whose name is Aḥīd,
his Family with the rightly guided Companions, O You Who through him have granted me the best religion.
And grant him peace, O Generous One, and lead to me all that I desire.
Bless and grant peace, O Right Guide (Ar-Rashīd), upon him through whom right direction appeared,
he whom You named Waḥīd (the Unique), O One, toward Whom I have led the affirmation of oneness,
his Family and his Companions, the masters, O You to Whom my habits are, as worship.
Bless and grant peace, O Giver of magnanimity, upon a magnified one whose name is Māḥī (the Effacer),
his Family and his Companions, valiant warriors, righteous, noble, protectors.
And bless and grant peace, O Powerful (Al-Qādir), O You toward Whose good pleasure I hasten,
upon a magnified one whose name is Ḥāshir (the Gatherer), and the Family and the Companions who laboured (at his side).
Bless the ʿĀqib (the Last), who is Ṭāhā, with Your peace, and increase him in rank,
his Family and his illustrious Companions, O You Who through him showed me the proofs.
Bless the best of creation, Yāsīn, with Your peace, and increase the adornment,
his Family and his Companions, the leaders, O You Who drive anguish away toward others than me.
And bless and grant peace, O Subduer (Al-Qāhir), upon a magnified one whose name is Ṭāhir (the Pure),
his Family and his Companions, true men, O You Who have protected all of me from fears.
Bless and grant peace, O All-Powerful (Al-Muqtadir), O You toward Whose good pleasure I rush,
